back_content.text: 结论：专家认为城市树木应被当作 public health infrastructure，而不只是 decoration；理由是它们能 reduce heat stress 并 encourage outdoor activity；但成效取决于 long-term maintenance。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Dr. Elaine Porter argues that urban trees should be treated as public health infrastructure, not merely decoration, because they reduce heat stress and encourage outdoor activity. However, she notes that the benefits depend on long-term maintenance, not just planting more trees.

tips: 听到 argues / believes / warns 时，先判断它后面是观点、理由还是限制。
however / but 后常补充边界，不能被前面的正向观点盖住。

back_content.text: 答案：B。专家认为 AI tutoring tools 可以提供 quicker feedback，但应 support teachers rather than replace them。

tips: 四选一先排除替换核心动词的选项，如 support 被改成 replace。
rather than 后面通常是专家明确排除的方向。

back_content.text: 结论：第一位专家认为 front-of-package labels 能帮助 shoppers make faster choices；另一位专家认为标签要配合 schools teach basic nutrition 才有效；两人都认为 labels alone 不能改变长期饮食习惯。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：One nutrition specialist believes front-of-package labels help shoppers make faster choices, while another argues that labels only work when schools also teach basic nutrition. Both agree that labels alone cannot change long-term eating habits.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：believes 和 argues 分别标出两位专家观点；while 表示对比；Both agree 引出共同边界。② 核心规律：双专家观点题要分开记录“谁认为 A、谁认为 B”，再总结共同点。③ 验证与纠偏：不要把第二位专家的学校教育条件听成否定标签；准确结论是 labels need support, not labels are useless。
tips: 听到 while another argues 时，立即把两位专家观点分栏记录。
Both agree 后面通常是共同结论，比单个细节更适合作答核验。

tips: even if + adverse condition = 让步条件，后主句动作仍需执行，是关键叮嘱。
to prevent = 目的状语，后接建议的原因，答案中必须包含 reason。

tips: far exceeding = 远超，是程度比较的高频表达，答案选项应含 significantly faster/much higher rate。
argue vs. warn = 学术立场 vs. 警告，前者较中性客观，后者含规范性建议。
